gau.title: Keeper — data exchange platform admin panel
gau.description: Enterprise SPA for exchange jobs, integration monitoring, reports, and admin of Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, ETL, and the scheduler via backend API.

highlights.architecture: Modular Vue 3, Composition API, Pinia, and Vue Router architecture with 15+ admin modules
highlights.realtime: Monitoring via WebSocket, SSE, and HTTP polling with connection management and UI status
highlights.library: Library of 15+ components: tables, forms, autocomplete, JSON viewer, and Markdown editor
highlights.markdown: Markdown editor with live preview, 8-language highlighting, Mermaid, task lists, and footnotes
highlights.grouping: useFolderGrouping composable: tree grouping, locale-aware sort, and expanded-node state
highlights.api: RBAC for 4 roles and 13 feature flags, EKIS ESA OAuth, and an API client for 100+ endpoints

gau.detailLead: A case about an enterprise admin panel: modular architecture, integration observability, and secure access.

gauHr.title: Management registers
gauHr.description: Corporate SPA for Moscow education system management registers: employee and organization cards, appointments, change history, reporting, and access control.

highlights.migration: Stepwise migration Vue 2 / Vuex / JavaScript / Vuetify 2 → Vue 3 / Pinia / TypeScript / Vuetify 4
highlights.registers: Three registers sharing lists, filters, and cards, with search and file uploads
highlights.ux: URL-synced filters and pagination; scroll and DOM preserved via RouteShell and keep-alive
highlights.rbac: Fine-grained RBAC: route guards, register filtering, conditional UI, and PII masking
highlights.api: Centralized Axios layer with typed endpoints, read-only directory cache, and toast errors
highlights.shared: Reusable mixins and shared components; themes, design tokens, and Vuetify global defaults

gauHr.detailLead: A case about migrating a legacy HR product: shared register shell, permission-based access, and large lists.

highlights.content: Analytics, CKEditor 5 content editor, and reusable tables

elros.detailLead: A case about a product ecosystem: ticket purchase, venue layouts, and organizer admin on one API.
